exercises: The largest cursor the constants allow, outside discovery and continuation (§3.1), built from the inputs below: 142,912 bytes, within CURSOR_BYTES. A store accepts it, and a cursor padded to exactly CURSOR_BYTES. Padded one byte past CURSOR_BYTES, the store refuses the frame by W4; the worker never emits it, and refuses with INVARIANT_FAILURE, because only content no constant allows (methods the registry does not have) gets a cursor that far. One refusal one byte past REFUSAL_BYTES is refused by W4 too; the worker names RESOURCE_LIMIT, cause cursor_refusal_bytes, because a refusal's detail can grow with the input.
